notes.title: Patch notes v2.3.5
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

    Fixed Temple Wall Puzzle where an wall turned incorrectly.
    Fixed gate clipping into the wall.
    Fixed boat and lift materials despawning unexpectedly.
    Fixed clipping objects in the House Map.
    Fixed TV widget not spawning correctly.
    Fixed TV material appearing translucent.
    Fixed carpet collision that caused players to be lifted up.
    Fixed mask interaction not functioning properly.
    Fixed widget issue on unlocked objects, which caused them to move after unlocking.
    Fixed end dial puzzle on the Compound level.
    Possible fix for tape not spawning on the second House Map.
    Fixed certain SFX sounds not being adjustable via the SFX slider.

Changes & Improvements

    Adjusted boss fight animations for better fluidity.
    Increased culling distance on items in the Mess Hall for better visibility.
    Improved puzzle validation by increasing how often the game checks if the code is correct.
    Overall game intensity increased for a more immersive horror experience.
    AI movement speed increased in the Forest Chase to enhance challenge and tension.

Work in Progress

    Brightness settings are currently being worked on for better visual customization.

notes.title: Hotfix patch v2.3.4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

    Replaced White Truck with a normal car to fix collision issues.
    Fixed Lift and Water Transport so that LODs don’t spawn when far away.
    Fixed Floor Collision at the Temple Entrance and consolidated sound sources.
    Fixed Light Bouncing off the metal shelf in the Kitchen by removing specular.
    Made the Crafting Screen smaller to prevent pixelation.
    Fixed the Note to Pierre in the Mess Hall to have proper collision.
    Potential fix for Boss Fight Music continuing after defeat.
    Fixed Non-Aligned Meshes for a more polished look.
    Fixed Note Detection issue preventing players from reading notes.

Changes

    Added New Hints for the Dial Puzzle.
    Rescaled Textures for improved visual quality.
    Full light rebuild due to lights bleeding trough objects

Work in Progress

    Fixing Texture Rendering Issues.
    Relighting Dark Areas for better visibility.
    Adding new Brightness Settings for player customization.
    Adding a Mouse Sensitivity Slider.
    Reworking SFX Sound Settings to address high-pitched noises.

notes.title: Patch notes V2.3.2
notes.content:
Changes

    Decreased visibility in Temple Map to enhance atmosphere.
    Added new notes in Compound to help players with progression.
    Added a guide to help players find the Gear.
    Added new cutscenes in Compound to enhance storytelling.
    Added Credits screen.
    Added new Menu Settings for improved player customization.

Bug Fixes

    Possible fix for Tape not spawning in the Second House.
    Fixed interaction widget not spawning on Mobile Home Door.
    Fixed collision issues on Dock.
    Removed overlay on Wall Lights.
    Removed Soft Focus effect.
    Fixed bug where players were unable to leave Inspection Mode.
    Fixed Fridge Sound not playing.
    Fixed bug preventing players from exiting NPC Interaction.
    Fixed bug causing Compound Chase Music to loop after player death.
    Fixed bug causing Saved Game to load even when it didn’t exist.
    Fixed players being stuck in Map Transition after using tape.

Work in Progress

    Sensitivity Settings for more control over player experience.
    Alternative Endings to provide varied narrative outcomes.

notes.title: Patch notes v2.3.1
notes.content:
Changes

    Doors on the House Map now rotate in the correct direction.
    Adjusted overlay on the mask for better visibility.
    Changed item name to match its description to complete the Gate Puzzle.
    Removed mesh that allowed players to walk up shelves on House Map.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed gap between door and wall on House Map.
    Fixed interaction prompt showing through walls on House Map.
    Fixed issue where the camera wasn’t removed after interaction.
    Fixed loud sound when bird flies past.
    Fixed excessively loud sound when opening the Church Door.
    Fixed missing collision next to Pierre’s Shack that allowed players to walk out of bounds.
    Fixed ceiling collision in the Mess Hall, allowing players to walk upstairs properly.
    Fixed locker sounds using incorrect default audio.
    Fixed arrow widget spawning in Mobile Home.
    Removed testing overlaps on House Map that allowed players to skip levels.
    Fixed bug where input hints were not displayed correctly.

Work in Progress

    Investigating inspection bug that prevents players from exiting inspect mode.
    Working on removing soft focus effect when close to objects.
    Adding sensitivity controls for better player customization.
    Investigating issue where tape is not spawning in the correct location for some players.
